integrity: Analytic proof for all stated parameters; standalone exact-rational finite checks supplement but do not replace proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-sphere-supported, moment-isotropic measures and independent sampling with replacement are covered.
No extension to general anisotropic sampling or higher moments; no quantitative near-equality theorem.
Potential earlier implicit coverage by Miles (1971) remains unresolved because full text was unavailable.
title: Sharp volume–centroid covariance bounds for moment-isotropic spherical simplices
